manual.ear_defenders.line2: {0}Ear Defenders are devices for protecting your hearing. They are quite important for engineers that work in close proximity to {1}Diesel Generators{2} or other loud machinery.{3}
manual.ear_defenders.line3: While wearing Ear Defenders, all noises are reduced by 90% and they make your ears considerably more warm and fuzzy! :D{0}
manual.ear_defenders.line4: Placing the Ear Defenders in the {0}Engineer's Workbench{1} allows you to specify which types of noises you want cancelled and by how much their volume should be reduced.{2}
manual.ear_defenders.line6: Crafting them with any other helmet will attach the defenders to that piece of equipment, crafting the helmet alone will remove the defenders again, to allow further customizing.{0}
manual.ear_defenders.line7: Ear defenders can be dyed the same as leather armor.
